author: JanGerritSchulz
body:
#### PR description:

The title says it already. This PR is extending the `HLTVertexTableProducer` to enable the additional filling of an SV table, and changes the configuration of the NGT Scouting Nano to make use of this. Compared to the previous SV table, this version includes also PV-denpent information (such as decay length, its significance or angle). This is also the main reason for including it in the existing table producer instead of creating a new one. 
This design choice is just a first suggestion. If a two producer approach is generally preferred, I can update this PR accordingly. 

#### PR validation:

I tested locally with 
```bash
runTheMatrix.py -l ph2_hlt -i all --ibeos
```
Everything passes.

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Not a backport

title: [NGT] Add full Secondary Vertex information to NGT Scouting Nano
